description: Written Premium LMM modeling for Dataset A Part 2. Evaluates agency-level (AGENCY_ID) and nested parent-agency (PRIMARY_AGENCY_ID/AGENCY_ID) random intercepts. Three controlled populations: FULL, PARENT_CC (excludes PAI=99999), TRUE_PARENT (excludes PAI=99999 and self-parent rows). REML=TRUE, bobyqa optimizer. Benchmarks: OLS_ADDITIVE_FINAL (test R²=0.7552) and RF_1_SAFE_TUNED (test R²=0.8839).

filters.na_exclusion: log_prev_wp or log_prev_poly NA rows excluded

modeling_population.random_effects: random intercept only — no random slopes

key_findings: AGENCY_NULL_FULL unconditional ICC = 0.1146 (agency accounts for 11.5% of total log_wp variance).
After OLS_ADDITIVE_FINAL fixed effects, residual agency ICC = 0.2422 (24.2% of residual variance).
AGENCY_LMM_FULL: conditional test R² = 0.7607 (OLS = 0.7552, delta = +0.0055); marginal test R² = 0.7345.
RF_1_SAFE_TUNED test R² = 0.8839 — still leads AGENCY_LMM_FULL conditional (0.7607).
NESTED_NULL_PARENT_CC: parent ICC = 0.0069, agency ICC = 0.0912, residual = 90.2%.
NESTED_LMM_PARENT_CC residual: parent ICC = 0.0438, agency ICC = 0.1312. Singular = FALSE.
NESTED_LMM_PARENT_CC vs AGENCY_LMM_PARENT_CC: delta conditional test R² = +0.0004.
TRUE_PARENT nested: parent ICC (null) = 0.0092; (full) = 0.0352. Singular = FALSE.

agency_lmm.justification: AGENCY_LMM_FULL conditional test R² = 0.7607 (delta vs OLS = +0.0055). Residual agency ICC = 0.2422. Singular = FALSE. Warnings = 1. Agency structure is visible in variance components but predictive gain is below threshold or convergence uncertain.

nested_lmm.justification: NESTED_LMM_PARENT_CC delta test R² vs agency-only = +0.0004 (below threshold 0.005). Parent variance share = 0.0438. Not singular. Parent structure exists in data but adds negligible predictive value beyond agency. Retain nested model as structural diagnostic only.

final_model_branch_status.ols_role: OLS_ADDITIVE_FINAL remains the interpretability benchmark (48 coefficients, locked specification).
final_model_branch_status.rf_role: RF_1_SAFE_TUNED remains the leading predictive model (test R² = 0.8839).
final_model_branch_status.lmm_role: AGENCY_LMM_FULL adds credibility/variance-decomposition interpretation (residual ICC = 0.2422). KEEP_AS_STRUCTURAL_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY
final_model_branch_status.nested_role: Nested LMM tests parent-agency structure. Parent variance share = 0.0438. KEEP_AS_STRUCTURAL_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY
